Methods and Tools for the Development of Mission-Critical Software-Intensive Systems
Size and complexity of Software increase dramatically in new systems. Moreover, it plays a more and more critical role in many application areas such as avionics, space, ground transportation, automotive, medical devices or nuclear plants. Like in many other engineering domains, size and complexity can be mastered by putting more effort in the early stages of the software development life-cycle. This is also the way to go to increase at the same time quality and productivity for a software intensive project. 
To achieve these goals, Ellidiss offers products, technologies and services that are focused on: 
- An industry proven software design methodology (HOOD). 
- A rigorous architectural design language for the software within its execution environment (AADL). 
- A powerful model processing technology based on the use of the prolog language (LMP).

entityDescription:
AdditiveLab BVBA specializes in finite-element based simulation solutions for metal Additive Manufacturing. Finite element based AM simulation is currently the only existing tool to predict potential metal powder-bed based manufacturing scenarios prior to the actual manufacturing process. AdditiveLab solves the needs of process engineers, design engineers, researchers and scientists working in AM who strive to efficiently investigate, understand and optimize their manufacturing processes. With this predictive capability researchers and engineers can virtually test and optimize different machine, material or manufacturing configurations, and subsequently reduce process failure risk and increase efficiency of the manufacturing process.

Competitive AM simulation solution providers offer predefined AM physics models with rigid workflows and restricted access to simulation data, limiting the users ability to create customized simulation models and in-depth simulation-based assessment of the process. AdditiveLab addresses these limitations; it is currently the only company offering software tool on the market that provides full and unrestricted access to all simulation functionality and simulation data to allow for extensive simulation customization and in-depth result assessment. This guarantees a more customized, accurate and efficient way to simulate the AM process.

AdditiveLab Company develops and distributes AdditiveLab RESEARCH and AdditiveLab LITE software. The software are sold on an annual basis limited to a specific machine at the customer site. In addition to the software, the AdditiveLab team also provides simulation consultancy services. These services are sold to AdditiveLab software’s existing users or to non-user companies based on customer demand.

entityName: DLR - INSTITUTE FOR SOLAR-TERRESTRIAL PHYSICS (DLR SO)
entityDescription:
The Institute for Solar-Terrestrial Physics scientific deals with the state and dynamics of the Ionosphere-Thermosphere-Magnetosphere System (ITM) and it´s driving by the Sun and by the lower and middle atmosphere. Within this research field, the Institute for Solar-Terrestrial Physics will focus on the study of Space Weather. Space Weather refers to conditions on the Sun and in the solar wind, magnetosphere, ionosphere and thermosphere that can influence the performance and reliability of space-borne and ground-based technological systems and endanger human life. Space Weather is known to possibly lead to significant perturbations of modern communication and navigation systems and hence to increased risks on safety, economical loss, and reduced life quality. The Institute for Solar-Terrestrial Physics covers both basic and applied research on space weather. The aim is to protect national infrastructures and support affected industries through timely, accurate and reliable observations and forecasts.
Main research focus areas are:
- Investigation of solar terrestrial processes in near Earth space to deepen the understanding of complex coupling processes primarily in the thermosphere and ionosphere and to derive information about potential space weather hazards and their prevention.
- Data-driven physical modelling of solar-terrestrial coupling processes based on energetic particle streams and radiation effects as well as corresponding propagation effects in near Earth space.
- Development of methods to measure, evaluate and predict physical as well as technical quantities, which describe the effects of space weather on technical systems.

Metaspectral is an artificial intelligence company developing advanced hyperspectral and multispectral data exploitation technologies for space, defence, environmental, and industrial applications. Its core capability is real-time AI-powered spectral intelligence: transforming high-dimensional satellite and airborne imagery into actionable insights about materials, objects, and environmental conditions. Metaspectral’s Clarity AI platform supports workflows such as material classification, spectral unmixing, target detection, anomaly detection, change detection, and quantitative estimation of physical or chemical properties.
For ESA, Metaspectral’s technology is relevant across next-generation Earth observation, onboard processing, and downstream applications. The company combines advanced hyperspectral compression, scalable AI analytics, agentic AI, and user-facing geospatial software to reduce data bottlenecks and make spectral imagery easier to analyze and operationalize. This can support use cases such as environmental monitoring, climate and greenhouse gas analysis, land restoration, resource mapping, maritime awareness, and security-related applications where material-level intelligence is critical.

A3 fosters research and development of technologies, products and services in the aerospace sector, ensuring economic and scientific benefit. 

Inter-mediation 
A3 is a focal point for the interconnection of economic entities in the domestic and international markets for the industry in the aerospace sector. A3 is a mediator between scientific research institutions and economic entities oriented to develop new technologies for aerospace sector with the aim of raising the profile of the domestic aviation space activities both on the domestic and international level. A3 is a focal point for the international aerospace agencies creating the environment where all stakeholders, i.e. industry, academy and public sector, are involved thus enabling the growth in this rapidly changing sector. 

Education and counselling 
A3 provides business and technology consulting for operators and government bodies, expert body to express their opinion on matters of public interest in the field of space technology and aeronautics and the link with supporting scientific and technical disciplines, education and popularization programs in aerospace sector. A3 inspires and supports education and training of the rising generation of qualified aerospace experts and scientists. 

Regional cooperation 
Cooperation rather than competition is the essence of success. Aerospace sector is especially demanding on wide range of knowledge and skills and without their sharing among the countries of the region, and beyond, individual effort of one country is predestined for failure. This observation is great motivation for A3 to congregate aerospace efforts into the regional cooperation.
